acceptance_criteria: Actual receipts prove current role reads, manager ownership/generation, one generic worker and authorized proposal/publication behavior.
Memory adds no reviewer, senior, separate implementer, Task activation side effect or unverified stopping claim.
tasks.action: Run a bounded native generic Task scenario through the actual host reservation, manager launch/reads/activation, one worker, proposal, scoped publication and completion/stopping flow. Use disposable Task inputs and retain actual native receipts.
risks: A remembered manager or helper fixture cannot substitute for real native activation; native capability failure remains a named unmet gate.
tasks.title: Exercise native generic memory use
verification_steps: Use native spawn/message/list/wait/interrupt as required and record genuine identities and lifecycle observations.
Reopen the disposable canonical Task and memory result, compare permissions and inspect actual stopped-state evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Every solver receives the same exact packet/baseline and confirmed model/effort; native inherited context excludes sibling content.
Complex work retains its full solver/senior topology without a mandatory per-candidate reviewer; accepted implementation uses a distinct authorized implementer when applicable.
tasks.action: Run a complex scenario with at least two independent full-problem solvers, including queued dispatch, a distinct senior and the dedicated implementer when implementation is requested. Bind the identical frozen packet before the first solver and defer sibling draft reads until all initial solvers launch.
risks: Queue within observed capacity without reducing the team; reject unsupported context inheritance rather than asking contaminated solvers to ignore it.
tasks.title: Exercise native complex frozen context
verification_steps: Inspect actual dispatch/input receipts, packet/source digests and native context evidence for each solver.
Plant a sibling sentinel and verify direct, indexed and inherited inputs; inspect synthesis/acceptance/implementation identity and stopping.

acceptance_criteria: The complete required logical team and one-to-one reviewer mapping are preserved through capacity queuing and revision.
Changed candidate/input versions invalidate affected reviews and downstream acceptance; no missing or stale pass is treated as current.
tasks.action: Run a bounded extra-complex scenario with distinct independent solvers, one distinct reviewer per solver, every current pass, a distinct senior and a dedicated implementer where authorized. Include a changed candidate to demonstrate stale review rejection.
risks: Do not lower model/effort, share reviewers or recategorize work to hide missing runtime capacity or a failed gate.
tasks.title: Exercise native extra-complex review gates
verification_steps: Record real identities, role reads, inheritance, exact candidates/reviews and native stop observations.
Exercise changed-candidate re-review and inspect actual senior/acceptance/implementation bindings.

acceptance_criteria: Running/uncertain owners are reconciled before material rebinding and current native receipts prove stopping; an immaterial edit has an explicit assessment.
Optional memory retry leaves committed/terminal Task events intact, while a required missing memory deliverable remains unmet.
tasks.action: During a bounded disposable execution, change a material accepted-memory input and demonstrate writer reconciliation, baseline revision, same-ID message/assignment.inputs rebinding and affected review/acceptance invalidation. Separately repair an optional memory failure without replaying the Task.
risks: Time, roster absence or a final message alone cannot revoke a writer; preserve uncertain owners as blockers.
tasks.title: Exercise native material-change and recovery gates
verification_steps: Inspect actual observe, stop, message, assignment.inputs and follow-up order with exact recipient/digest references.
Compare canonical Task history and memory journals before/after recovery and reject stale actor/generation attempts.
